title: Active Queries and Connections
description: Show all active database connections and their current queries, including execution duration.
sql:
SELECT pid, age(clock_timestamp(), query_start) AS duration, usename, query, state
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state != 'idle'
  AND query NOT LIKE '%pg_stat_activity%'
ORDER BY duration DESC;

title: Database Sizes
description: List all databases in the server along with their size on disk, formatted nicely.
sql:
SELECT pg_database.datname,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(pg_database.datname)) AS size
FROM pg_database
ORDER BY pg_database_size(pg_database.datname) DESC;

title: Table Size Breakdown
description: Show size breakdown of tables in the current database, including table size, index size, and total size.
sql:
SELECT relname AS table_name,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)) AS total_size,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(c.oid)) AS table_size,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) - pg_relation_size(c.oid)) AS index_size
FROM pg_class c
LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
  AND c.relkind = 'r'
ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) DESC
LIMIT 20;

title: Unused Indexes
description: Identify indexes that are rarely or never scanned, which consume disk space and slow down writes.
sql:
SELECT schemaname, relname AS table_name, indexrelname AS index_name,
       idx_scan AS number_of_scans, idx_tup_read, idx_tup_fetch
FROM pg_stat_user_indexes
WHERE idx_scan = 0
  AND indexrelname NOT LIKE 'pg_%'
ORDER BY relname, indexrelname;

title: Cache Hit Rate (Tables & Indexes)
description: Calculate how often data is read from the cache vs. disk. Ideally, it should be > 99%.
sql:
SELECT 
  'table' AS type,
  sum(heap_blks_hit) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(heap_blks_read) + sum(heap_blks_hit), 0) AS ratio
FROM pg_statio_user_tables
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'index' AS type,
  sum(idx_blks_hit) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(idx_blks_read) + sum(idx_blks_hit), 0) AS ratio
FROM pg_statio_user_indexes;

title: Duplicate Indexes
description: Find redundant indexes (indexes on the same column set in the same order) that consume storage.
sql:
SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(i.indexrelid)) AS size,
       i.indrelid::regclass AS table_name,
       i.indexrelid::regclass AS index_name,
       array_to_string(array_agg(a.attname), ', ') AS columns
FROM pg_index i
JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = i.indexrelid
GROUP BY i.indrelid, i.indexrelid, i.indisunique
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY pg_relation_size(i.indexrelid) DESC;
